driver: the developer single-tick step (issue #253) refuses while main-menu, without sampling, stepping or rendering
startGameWith: the developer single-tick step (issue #253) does nothing while the match is playing
why: The step runs whatever the session is doing. From a live match it hands out a tick the frame loop is also about to take, so the match runs one tick fast per press; from a menu or an ended round it moves a world nobody is playing. Issue #253's step is a paused-board tool, and the gate is what makes it one.
